data.narrative: Successfully implemented full Graceful Degradation resilience patterns in FastAPI API application. Created thread-safe CircuitBreaker (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN states), explicit request timeouts (1.0-2.0s), and exponential backoff retry mechanism with randomized jitter (+/-50ms) to prevent thundering herd spikes.

dimension_scores.observation: Maintained clean container health checks and non-root execution alongside circuit breaker integration.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified API container resilience under dependency failure.

dimension_scores.observation: Resilience layer integration verified by CI pipeline lint and test gates.
Circuit state transitions (circuit_opened, circuit_half_open, circuit_closed) and retry attempts log structured events.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added logger extra payloads for circuit_opened, circuit_closed, and retry_attempt.

dimension_scores.observation: Anticipated thundering herd risks and solved with backoff jitter; avoided infinite retry loops with max_retries cap.
dimension_scores.evidence: Capped max_retries at 3 and added uniform random jitter offset.

dimension_scores.observation: Built complete CircuitBreaker state machine with fast fallback when open and HALF_OPEN trial recovery.
dimension_scores.evidence: Created app/resilience.py with CircuitBreaker and retry_with_backoff.

dimension_scores.observation: Documented timeout math, circuit thresholds, and product fallback impact in code docstrings and evaluation logs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added complete docstrings and log event schemas in app/resilience.py.

strengths: Thread-safe CircuitBreaker implementation preventing cascading database failures and connection pool exhaustion.
Exponential backoff with jitter preventing thundering herd spikes during dependency recovery.
data.recommendation: Proceed to Module 07 (Runbooks & Operational Documentation) to write operational guides for on-call engineers.
